fields.System.Title: RET-103 — Query open RMAs
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a returns clerk, I want to look up an RMA when a parcel arrives, so that I know what
is expected inside it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an RMA reference, then I get the expected products, quantities, customer, and
  • original order.
  • - Given a customer name or original order reference, then I can search for their open
  • RMAs.
  • - Given an expired or fully received RMA, then it does not appear in the open list.
  • - Given a partly received RMA, then it appears with outstanding quantities.
